verdict.rationale: Docs show deferred/human-approval tool gating (fine-grained permission control) and a coding-agent mode with 'workspace-rooted file access' and 'allowlisted shell', which restrict what an agent can do, but there's no explicit sandboxed execution environment (e.g., container/VM isolation) documented or corroborated independently. missing for 10: explicit sandboxing mechanism (container/VM/process isolation), granular per-tool permission policy docs beyond approval gating, and independent verification of these safety controls in practice.
